# Pact Protocol (repository)

> Stellar/Soroban port of Pact Protocol — trustless creator–brand deals with AI agents, DealVault escrow, and PactTrade markets.

This file lives at the monorepo root for GitHub and documentation crawlers. The production web app serves richer context at `/llms.txt` and `/llms-full.txt` on the deployed frontend.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): Overview, architecture, testnet contracts, setup
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): Agent/developer brief with deployed addresses
- [Frontend llms.txt](frontend/public/llms.txt): Web-facing LLM index
- [GitHub](https://github.com/fahmmin/pact-protocol-stellar)

## Monorepo

- `contracts/` — Soroban Rust smart contracts
- `agents/` — Python FastAPI AI agent runtime
- `frontend/` — Next.js 14 UI
- `specs/` — Protocol specifications

## Network

Stellar **Testnet** — verify contracts on https://stellar.expert/explorer/testnet
